import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

What changed, in [web_clip_adapter.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_21/scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py) and [web_clip_render.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_21/scripts/web_clip/web_clip_render.py):

- **Redirect-chain SSRF (A):** new `_private_landing_url` walks `nav.request.redirected_from` plus `page.url` after every `goto` (headless and headed paths) and raises a `network` refusal on any non-global hop. Skipped for fixture route-hooks and `--html` captures, which serve no live network.
- **WebSocket SSRF (B):** new `_install_ws_guard` installs `context.route_web_socket("**/*", …)` next to each `_install_guard`, proxying only `ws`/`wss` URLs to globally routable hosts via `connect_to_server()` and closing everything else. Verified against the pinned Playwright 1.62 API (`BrowserContext.route_web_socket`, `WebSocketRoute.url/close/connect_to_server` all exist).
- **Positional img parsing (C):** new `_img_attr`/`_set_img_src` helpers in both files replace whole-tag `src=` regex search/substitution in `_localize_images`, `normalize_images`, and `prefix_part_assets`. Removed the now-dead `_SRC_ATTR_RE` in the renderer.
- **Literal origin insertion (D):** the `data-bob-origin` `re.sub` now uses a lambda replacement so `\1`/`\g` in image URLs can't raise `invalid group reference`.

Verification: `just check-web-clip-adapter` gate green (`py_compile` + self-test exit 0, `ok`), with 10 new regression checks (mocked private redirect refusal, WS allow/block, origin query with `src=` surviving render plus prefixing, alt-text `src=` shadowing, backslash-URL localization). A scratch probe confirmed the old code failed all three image cases. The `TargetClosedError` teardown noise reproduces identically on the base tree, and `epic-symbols` reports no leftovers.
